description_en: Deletes a data source sharing rule by its ID
description_zh: 根据数据源分享规则ID，删除一条数据源分享规则
name: DeleteDataSourceSharedRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source sharing rule. You can call the ListDataSourceSharedRules operation to query existing sharing rules and their IDs
parameters.help_zh: 数据源分享规则ID。 您可以调用 ListDataSourceSharedRules 查询已有分享规则及其 ID
parameters.name: id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the data source sharing rule was deleted. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
数据源分享规则是否删除成功，取值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
